title: Day of the Lord
gist: A day when God acts decisively: sometimes judgement on Israel and the nations, sometimes rescue. The prophets use it as a warning (Amos says it is darkness, not light); the New Testament speaks of it as the day of Christ's return, coming 'like a thief'.
original: Hebrew yom YHWH; Greek hemera kyriou.

passages.note: 'Woe to them that desire the day of the Lord.'
'The day of the Lord shall so come as a thief in the night.'
The day will come as a thief.
